page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, providing 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. The system includes 256 GB of system RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. It does not include local instance storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage architectures, with a baseline network bandwidth rated at 6 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate consistent mid-tier multithreaded capacity paired with lower single-thread throughput. Single-core tests such as Geekbench (945.0) and single-core stress-ng (1108.09) reflect modest per-core performance, mirrored by lower decompression and compression rates. Conversely, aggregate multithreaded execution reaches average tiers, showing a PassMark CPU score of 23224.93 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8252.0. Large-block memory bandwidth registers 98.84 GB/sec for uncached reads and 48.76 GB/sec for uncached writes, enabling solid data transfer across its 256 GB memory pool.

From a cost-efficiency and operational standpoint, the instance delivers large memory capacity per core without the premium required for dedicated local NVMe arrays or GPU accelerators. The primary performance tradeoff centers on the single-core compute performance, which limits throughput on unparallelized tasks. The high RAM footprint and balanced multi-core capability make this server well suited for in-memory caching systems like Redis, large-footprint relational or analytical databases, medium-scale distributed ETL jobs, and enterprise memory-intensive applications.

The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 256 GB of system memory. It provides a baseline network throughput of 6 Gbps, while omitting local disk storage and GPU hardware. Benchmark results demonstrate modest single-core throughput, balanced by capable multithreaded processing with a PassMark CPU score of 23224.93 and solid memory bandwidth registering 98.84 GB/sec for uncached reads. The 8 GB of RAM per vCPU ratio makes this configuration efficient for memory-dense enterprise services without the operational overhead of localized storage. The server is well aligned with workloads such as large in-memory databases, Redis caching clusters, enterprise resource planning systems, and large-scale data transformation pipelines.
